FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF CHAIRMAN OF THE
MATHUGAMA PRADESHIYA SABHA
UNDER SECTION 65A (1) OF THELOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE
(CHAPTER 262) AS AMENDED BY LOCAL AUTHORITIES (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT No. 30 OF 2013
WHEREAS the office of Chairman in Mathugama Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Resignation ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the United People's Freedom Alliance the recognized political party, to whichLiyana Arachchige Gunasena Liyanaarachchi the Former Chairman belonged, was required by me under Section 65A(1) ofthe aforesaid Ordinance, to decide upon the member of that Mathugama Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs to such party whoshall be declared elected as Chairman within a period of thirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his nominatedMr. Don Roshan Manoj Priyantha Jayasingha to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE I, Hannedige Rasika Priyanga Peiris, Returning Officer of Mathugama Pradeshiya Sabha,acting in terms of Section 65A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance as amended by filling of vacancies in LocalAuthorities (Special Provisions) Act, No. 30 of 2013 (Chapter 262) do hereby declare Mr.Don Roshan Manoj PriyanthaJayasingha elected as Chairman of the Mathugama Pradeshiya Sabha.
RASIKA PEIRIS,Returning Officer,Mathugama Pradeshiya Sabha.District Elections Office,Kalutara,27th April, 2015.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk.

FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF CHAIRMAN OF THE

WHEREAS the office of Chairman in Rajgama Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of death ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the United People's Freedom Alliance the recognized political party, to whichAgampodi Manoj Pushpakumara Mendis the Former Chairman belonged, was required by me under Section 65A(1) of theaforesaid Ordinance, to decide upon the member of that Rajgama Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs to such party who shall bedeclared elected as Chairman within a period of thirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision tonominate Mr. Nimal Thommadura to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE I, Anthony Bimal Indrajith De Silva, Returning Officer of Rajgama Pradeshiya Sabha, actingin terms of Section 65A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance as amended by filling of vacancies in Local Authorities(Special Provisions) Act, No. 30 of 2013 (Chapter 262) do hereby declare Mr.Nimal Thommadura elected as Chairman of theRajgama Pradeshiya Sabha.
A. B. I. DE SILVA,Returning Officer,Rajgama Pradeshiya Sabha.District Elections Office,Galle,27th April, 2015.
